go tool

# Tools already in the tool directory should not be listed twice.
stdout -count=1 '^compile$'

# Stripped builtin tools should still be listed (go.dev/issue/75960).
stdout '^nm$'
stdout '^objdump$'
stdout '^pprof$'

# Non-main packages should not appear.
! stdout '^tools$'
! stdout '^api$'
